flat_artwork_prompt: Use case: illustration-story / product-mockup artwork. Create a flat panoramic illustration for a Utkal coffee-cup wrap, WIDE approximately 200:85 aspect ratio, entirely on warm ivory background. It tells a GRAPHICAL story, no explanatory words whatsoever. Contemporary Odisha maritime memory, inspired by rhythmic hand-painted Indian coastal storytelling, refined flat shapes and delicate hand-drawn linework, limited colours deep sea blue #1D4658, laterite rust #91462F, straw gold #C1A263 and warm ivory #F2E6D0. A continuous left-to-right narrative across three connected scenes WITHOUT panel boxes: LEFT: a quiet Odisha riverbank at dawn, two small human figures in simple draped clothing kneeling at the bank and lowering tiny leaf boats with small glowing lamps onto the water; reeds and a distant palm. CENTRE: the ripples flow into an expansive sea, a graceful traditional two-sail trading boat crossing the water, with a small sun and two seabirds overhead; use a clear boat silhouette and subtle hand-drawn details, no warships. RIGHT: the same sea meets a palm-lined shore with simple low buildings and people greeting a arriving boat, modest pottery baskets on the shore indicating exchange; no identifiable historical monument or literal map. This is an imaginative maritime story, not a claimed reconstruction. Along the entire lower edge a beautifully restrained continuous wave border ties all scenes together. Upper edge airy with ivory breathing room. Elegant collectible lifestyle design, clearly legible composition on a curved cup, major forms large enough to read. NO paragraphs, NO captions, NO lettering, NO watermark, NO invented scripts, NO photo of a mug, NO mockup; only finished flat wrap artwork. Keep outer 5 percent clean so edges and handle zone have breathing room.
mockup_prompt: Use case: product-mockup / compositing. Reference image 1 is the ORIGINAL FLAT ARTWORK to wrap onto a mug: preserve its illustrated three-scene narrative and colour palette closely. Reference image 2 is ONLY a reference for the mug shape, ivory body, sea-blue handle and interior, studio lighting and background. REMOVE the old oversized book logo and lettering from that cup. Create a polished two-view studio presentation of the SAME Utkal Story Cup shown from different rotations, side by side. Cup one shows the central sea voyage and part of the tiny boat-launch scene; cup two reveals the boat-launch and welcoming-shore portions of the same continuous wrap. Printed illustration should curve realistically around the ceramic, retain ivory breathing room near the rim, and keep the sea-blue/straw lower ornamental wave border. Add only small, unobtrusive sea-blue 'UTKAL' branding near the rim, in one place on the wrap. The imagery is the star. Absolutely NO story paragraphs, NO captions, NO other text, NO big logo replacing the story. Soft natural light, subtle shadows, elegant e-commerce product photography, warm cream backdrop. Make the panorama legible, richly drawn, not clip art. These are two views of one design, not two different cup designs.
